## Inline and display mathematics

Inline LaTeX: $V \otimes_k W$.

Display LaTeX:

$$
\dim_k(V \otimes_k W) = \dim_k(V)\dim_k(W).
$$

::: {#thm-example}
## Dimension of a tensor product

For finite-dimensional vector spaces $V$ and $W$ over a field $k$,
the dimension of their tensor product is the product of their dimensions.
:::

::: {.proof}
If $(v_i)$ and $(w_j)$ are bases, the tensors $v_i \otimes w_j$ form a basis
of $V \otimes_k W$.
:::

Refer to @thm-example. Citations can be added with a BibTeX file and
`bibliography: references.bib` in the front matter.
